budget_rule: Two million interactions times ceil(eight-action graph diameter / 10). This uses the earlier twenty-seed maze pilot and geometry, not new test success: 2M for Maze4, Maze5, Maze6, Maze7 and MazeMA; 4M for Woods14. Equal budget for both agents. No convergence claim.

primary_metric.within_seed: Equally weighted mean success over every registered nominal evaluation point.
primary_metric.across_seeds: Mean and standard error across seeds 42-61; 95% Student t(19) interval, critical value 2.093024054408263.
primary_metric.paired_difference: ACS2ER minus ACS2 within each seed; mean and t(19) 95% interval across twenty differences.
primary_metric.threshold: First registered nominal point where across-seed mean test success reaches 0.5 times the test ceiling. No interpolation; null if never reached.

rejection_criterion.floor: If neither final test lower 95% confidence bound exceeds its random floor: floor_baselines_retain_for_successors.
rejection_criterion.ceiling: Otherwise, if ACS2 mean test success at the first point is at least 0.9 times its ceiling: too_easy_no_speed_ranking.
rejection_criterion.retention: Keep every configuration and all three blocks regardless of verdict.

cost_rule.job_limit: ceil((2.5 * seed42 body wall seconds at the registered budget + 90) / 60) minutes per agent, with mixed arrays taking the larger limit for every element.
cost_rule.forecast: Twenty times the sum over both agents and six mazes of seed42 body wall at budget plus measured nonnegative allocation overhead. Report a doubled forecast separately. Pilot allocation seconds come from final allocation-only sacct records.
cost_rule.layout: Six arrays of forty single-CPU jobs, one configuration per array, concurrency forty, chained by afterok. Check pilot plus spent plus reserved plus all new limits against forty CPU-hours before every submission.
